feed.title: Standardizing public key exposure classification for existing outputs

entry.title: Standardizing public key exposure classification for existing outputs
entry.summary:
The proposed specification aims to classify Bitcoin outputs based on the exposure status of their public keys, addressing a significant gap in the current Bitcoin Improvement Proposals (BIPs). While BIP 360 introduces an output type that keeps the key off-chain until required for a script-path spend and BIP 361 suggests a phased discontinuation of legacy signature verifications, neither addresses how to determine if an existing output’s key is exposed. The lack of such a specification leads to varied estimates of exposed supplies, ranging from approximately 25% to over 34%, primarily due to differing definitions rather than measurement inaccuracies.
The draft in discussion introduces a classification system with four distinct levels: EXPOSED_AT_REST, EXPOSED_ON_SPEND, NOT_EXPOSED, and UNDETERMINED. It also includes a per-output-type assignment table and implements a fail-closed rule, where the more-exposed level must be assigned if data is insufficient to distinguish between two levels. This approach aims to standardize responses across different tools and platforms, ensuring consistency when identifying vulnerable outputs. Notably, the proposal clarifies that the disclosure mechanism does not affect the exposure level classification, countering a common misconception that reused addresses might be safer than directly exposed ones like P2PK.
The specification mandates an UNDETERMINED classification for unrecognized output types to avoid mistakenly reporting them as safe. It also sets a constant-time floor to prevent inaccurate NOT_EXPOSED classifications due to truncated history scans. Moreover, the draft explicitly excludes risk scoring from its scope, focusing solely on observable data to ensure that any subsequent calculations are based on consistent information.
The draft, along with its reference implementation and test vectors, can be found [here](https://github.com/duncan0k/pubkey-exposure-classification). Furthermore, this topic was initially posted on Delving Bitcoin and has been shared on the Bitcoin Development Mailing List for broader feedback, which can be viewed at [Delving Bitcoin forum](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/standardizing-an-exposure-classification-for-existing-outputs-pre-bip/2866). The developer seeks feedback on the utility of this specification for wider application and is open to suggestions, especially concerning any overlooked prior art in this area.
